images.author: Steve Dock
images.description: Pictured is the GLOCK 17 Gen 4 pistol. In 2013 the British Ministry of Defence signed a £9-million-pound contract to provide the Armed Forces with more than 25,000 new Glock side arms. images.title: Glock 17 G5 FR.jpg
images.author: Arnaud KLOPFENSTEIN/French Army
images.description: A French soldier with his Glock 17 Gen 5 FR during a shooting session (Mission Jeanne d'Arc 2022). Embarked on the French Navy's LHD FS Mistral, a French battlegroup, composed of detachments from the 3rd Marine Infantry Regiment, the 11th Marine Artillery Regiment and the 6th Engineer Regiment, carried out a series of exercises with allies from various countries.
